# Elanster Technologies

> Elanster Technologies is an AI research and product engineering company based in Chennai, India, serving clients worldwide. A senior team builds full-stack AI products, agents and RAG pipelines, with a first working build typically in 4 to 12 weeks.

## What we do
- AI Research
- AI Integration into existing products
- AI Agents & Automation
- Full-Stack App Development (web, mobile, cloud)
- AI Consulting

## How we work
- Strategy call, then a fixed-scope build, an embedded product team or an ongoing partnership
- Two meetings a week: sprint planning on Monday, sprint review on Friday
- Working software every week; support after launch
